review_text:
I bought this BT speaker because my old [not Keiid] gave up on me. The first order came but the power doesn't work. I switched to every outlet in my home just in case the electricity is fluctuating. Unfortunately, it wasn't. So, I chatted Amazon for possible replacement and they did replace it will no hassles. This came today, 07/18/2020 around 3 pm. As you can see the package is wrapped with plastic. I heard the delivery person tossed the package, mishandling it. Didn't think if the item is breakable or not. Luckily, it wasn't.

So, the item is working so far. But, the sound is subpar. I have had several BT speakers with good sound quality. By the way, I am an audiophile. I have a degree in Sound Engineering. The reason I bought this instead of creating one is that I got lazy. Below are my observations;

1. Made of aluminum at almost a 1 mm thick. It molded into a rectangular shape. Good molding.
2. Wires are okay. This could have upgraded this to braided armor nylon instead of speaker wires that easily stretched.
3. I didn't try to open the speakers [I usually do] but I am sure there are sound-deadening materials.
4. The speaker cone driver is 2 inches is aluminum [majority of these tiny speakers] should have vented coils.
5. The majority of these tiny speakers should have passive radiators to sound like big speakers.
6. If you're not familiar with optical interferometry, this is how to measure vibration with amplitude. I'm not going for specifics but the speaker vibrates at higher bass holds in above medium volume. Going to a max volume, the cone will probably triple the vibration and will cause damage for prolong use.
7. The speakers should be screwed to a plastic material [I'm 99 percent sure it's not aluminum, resin, or some type of compressed wood material].

An overall observation of this speaker, Keiid will do just fine. But, in my standards, I give it 3-stars. The DSP control is okay, If you're in a bigger room, it may sound flat but will not fill the entire room with good bass output. But, it will do fine in small bedroom. Bear in mind, these speakers don't have tweeters. The speakers serve like 2-in-one. If you bring this BT speaker to your travels, not recommended, but that's entirely up to you. If you use it for gaming speakers, it has three modes to select; Gaming, Movie, and Music auto equalization. My assessment. It's a little bit flat for gaming. It's good when watching movies---movie mode. Listening to music is okay. The bass is midrange. I hope this helps.

You can view in YouTube for more detailed reviews.
claim: 1. Made of aluminum at almost a 1 mm thick. It molded into a rectangular shape. Good molding.  Wires are okay. This could have upgraded this to braided armor nylon instead of speaker wires that easily stretched.
notes: Explained in detailed but photo only shows some details

product_title: NACODEX 132 Keys Gradient Blue PBT Keycaps Set, Cherry Profile Lake Blue Summer Keycap for 61/87/ 104/108 Mechanical Keyboard, Compatible with Cherry/Gateron/Otemu/Kailh Switch
review_text:
NACODEX Keycaps Review

Unique profile, interesting colorway

This keycaps set has a unique JSA profile, a high profile that focuses on the alphanumeric rows. The keys on the number row, for example, measure 14.7mm at their thickest point. The overall profile is similar to that of the SA profile in that the outer rows are shorter than the middle rows. The overall height is pretty tall compared to, say, the Cherry profile.

When I first saw the product pictures I thought the light colored keys were an off-white, cream color but in person they actually have a pink hue, a light, muted rose color. I think I actually prefer this. It goes well with the grey keys, which use the same hue for its printing.

On the number row, the numbers are above the shift characters. Why is that? This is inconsistent with other keys like the comma key that has its shift character above. It's obviously a stylistic choice but not one that I like but can get used to.

The left and right curly brackets keys do not show the square brackets as they're shift characters.

The JSA profile does not emphasize the bottom row nor the function key row. There is quite a bit of height difference between, say, the Shift key and the Control key below it. This profile does take some getting used to especially if you use the Control key and other modifiers frequently. The Space key is angled towards the front of the keyboard and is elevated slight higher than the modifier keys next to it.

The directional (arrow) keys are a higher profile though. On a TKL layout, these keys stand out nicely. On smaller layout though they may stand out too much next to the shorter control key next to them, but the manufacturer has a solution as 4 lower profile directional keys are included in the box as well. That's a nice touch.

The number row keys have a visible taper to them in that the front of the key is wider than the rear, another interesting stylistic choice.

I installed this keycaps set on a Keychron K8 keyboard that is usually paired with a Mac. The keycaps set unfortunately does not come with macOS Command and Option keys but the Windows and Alt keys are a workable replacement. As a Mac user I do have to do that if I want to try interesting keycaps. The Keychron is a high profile keyboard and these keys look good sitting atop Gateron G Pro switches.

If you love RGB lighting, be aware that these keys are not shine through, but they do sit up high up enough on the switches to still offer up a nice light show on the Keychron.

Installed on the K8, the space bar sounds very hollow, not a good sound at all compared to the stock space bar. A bunch of dampening on the underside of the space bar will probably help with this, a project for another day. The other keys sound very good, relatively speaking.

Overall this is a very well constructed keycaps set. It certainly has its unique profile and interesting stylistic choices. I would like it to have a better sounding space bar and, given that it comes with keys that have icons printed on them, a few extra modifier keys for macOS users would be appreciated. The jury is out on whether or not I like this tall JSA profile but time will tell.
claim: It goes well with the grey keys, which use the same hue for its printing.The Keychron is a high profile keyboard and these keys look good sitting atop Gateron G Pro switches.
notes:
The other keys sound very good, relatively speaking.

Overall this is a very well constructed keycaps set. It certainly has its unique profile and interesting stylistic choices.

review_text:
I have been in the keyboard hobby for over a year now, and I can confidently say these are a great value! The legends are simple and crisp, and while not as thick as some manufacturers, these keycaps are of better quality than other keycaps that cost twice as much (see photos for comparison against EnjoyPBT).

I was very pleased to see how many keycaps are provided for the price. Not only does this set of keycaps fit common sizes such as 65%, TKL, and full-size keyboards, but this set also fits less common layouts including Arisu/Alice, 96%, HHKB, and more at a lower price than other vendors who provide far fewer keycaps.

The colors are consistent, and almost match the Glorious novelty key I have, which is cool. The sound profile will depend on many factors but will fall more on the clacky side in my opinion. As these are OEM profile keycaps, there is no concern about interference when using keyboards with north-facing LEDs which can be an issue with Cherry profile keycaps.

While not endgame worthy, these Keycaps would be an excellent choice for budget and entry-level custom keyboards without hesitation (Looking at you Drop, GMMK, RK, CIY, etc.) I look forward to increased colorways from this manufacturer as I feel they are a great value and bring more competition to the space.
claim: these Keycaps would be an excellent choice for budget and entry-level custom keyboards without hesitation.

The grooves that the glass sits in are circles that tv mounting hardware spacers fit in. A longer a screw will be needed and that can be picked up at any Home Depot.

3. 240 mm radiator can’t fit on the top of the case but it can be Jerry rigged to the front fans for water cooling.

I don't love glossy do I may pop this protector out and use the matte instead. I will just be careful not to fully damage the case.

The case is NOT waterproof by any means, but I have an externship at an animal emergency hospital coming up and I know that I have to bring my iPad for a few things for my school. I figured a built in screen for now may make clean up easier and may protect my iPad a bit better.

Overall I would get it again. While I wish it were thinner, I didn't get a thinner case for a few reasons state above.
